content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-138. - Assessment roll; certification.
content.summary:
Upon the passage of an ordinance, as hereinbefore provided, the engineer shall make
               out an assessment roll according to the provisions of said ordinance and shall certify
               the same to the council, as provided in
section 78-99
.
(Code 1981, § 27-138; Ord. No. 551, § 79, 5…
